rationale_summary: The grounded norms collectively support the single CP criterion on systems of controls for traceability and integrity. They are grouped by facility type and aspect (controls vs integrity) as SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION, as no explicit connector in the CP or rules establishes cumulative or alternative relationships among these provisions.
